headline: Opskeep can now plan a new project with you before anything gets built.
highlights: Say "new project" and Opskeep starts from the problem you're solving, then runs a short, visual design workshop where you click and point instead of answering a questionnaire.
You get 2-3 design directions and a dashboard to confirm or change each decision. Nothing is built until you approve.
If you change your mind later (for example "make it mobile-first"), only the affected decisions are reopened.

verticals.update: git -C <clone folder> pull, then copy verticals/<pack>/skills/* into the agent's skills folder again
